summary: Batch must consult concurrent slots and remaining daily budget before every submit, and generation polling must correlate finished designs to the submitted prompt and cursor rather than any newer ID.
reason: Without --wait, batch slept one second and submitted blindly, exceeding concurrent/daily capacity. Polling treated every completed design above the pre-submit max ID as this invocation, so a concurrent browser or CLI session could be reported or downloaded instead.
validated_outcome: Unit tests cover quota submit decisions and prompt/cursor correlation; go test ./internal/cli/ and go build ./... pass.
